sources.method: Opened the official Tiebreaking Procedures page.

sources.claim: 'Most often, the betting odds for point spread are -110.' Also: 'if the point spread was +10/-10 and the favored team wins by exactly 10 or the underdog loses by exactly 10, you would push and get your initial wager returned.' The article body explains the point spread, not the moneyline.
sources.method: Opened the official article; body/title mismatch confirmed and flagged.

sources.claim: 'In a moneyline wager, the bettor focuses just on who will be the winner of the match.' Also: 'If the game ends in a tie, the bettor's wager is returned with no loss or profit.' The article body explains the moneyline, not the point spread.
sources.method: Opened the official article; body/title mismatch confirmed and flagged.

sources.claim: 'It takes thousands of computers and a team of NFL executives to create the NFL's 272-game masterpiece.' 'Each NFL team plays 17 games over the 18-week season. The league uses a formula to determine all 272 matchups.'
sources.method: Opened the official Making the Schedule page.

sources.claim: 'The NFL is spending $6.2 million to help expand programs to prevent or treat problem gambling across the country.' The initiative is 'aimed at getting fans to set limits on their wagers, understand the risks of betting, and know where to get help'. Article carries a 2021 Associated Press copyright.
sources.method: Opened the official NFL news article.

sources.claim: Version 4.0, last modified 2026-10-06. 'If the odds offered on a particular selection are -110, that means in order to win (profit) $100, you would need to wager $110.' 'Multiplier odds represent the total return for every $1 wagered, including the money you risked.'
sources.method: Opened the official DraftKings Understanding Odds article and its version history.

sources.claim: Version 5.0, last modified 2026-06-29. 'The favorite will have negative points while the underdog will have positive points.' 'If the score ends in a tie after your points are added/subtracted the bet pushes and your wager is returned.'
sources.method: Opened the official DraftKings point-spread article and its version history.

sources.claim: Version 4.0, last modified 2026-06-29. 'All added bets must win in order for the parlay to win. If one selection in the parlay loses, the whole parlay loses. If a selection results in a push, it is removed from the parlay and the odds are recalculated accordingly.' 'For certain selections, the outcomes can be considered correlated. In these cases, DraftKings reserves the right to restrict parlay betting on these outcomes.'
sources.method: Opened the official DraftKings parlay article and its version history.

sources.claim: Version 5.0, last modified 2026-08-18. 'A Same Game Parlay (SGP) works the same as a regular parlay but allows you to combine multiple outcomes from the same game.' 'Due to the nature of the bet type, SGP odds are calculated differently than in other types of parlay bets.' Voided non-participating-player legs adjust the odds in applicable states.
sources.method: Opened the official DraftKings SGP article and its version history.

sources.claim: Version 3.0, last modified 2026-06-29. 'A prop bet or proposition bet is a wager on an individual player or specific event in a game/match that is not directly connected to the outcome of a game.'
sources.method: Opened the official DraftKings prop-bet article and its version history.

sources.claim: Version 5.0, last modified 2026-06-29. 'Generally, if a player starts or meets the playing time requirements as described in the House Rules, then all bets will stand and be settled accordingly.' Complete player-prop settlement is directed to the sport-specific House Rules (NFL page linked).
sources.method: Opened the official DraftKings player-start/removal article.

sources.claim: 'If a whole number is offered as the point spread or handicap, bets will be settled as Push if the outcome bet on is tied after the point spread or handicap for the bet has been applied.' 'If the Selections tie, bets will be settled as Push' (2-way moneyline). 'If the total points ... scored in the Event is equal to the specified Total for the bet, then the bet will be settled as Push.'
sources.method: Opened the official DraftKings Market Rules page.

sources.claim: Effective Date: July 30, 2026. Section 19, 'Parlays, Round Robins and Teasers': 'A parlay bet consists of two or more selections, all of which must win for the overall bet to win.' 'Parlays containing selections where the outcome of one selection directly affects the outcome or pricing of another selection are not permitted, unless explicitly offered by FanDuel Sportsbook, e.g., as a Same Game Parlay bet.'
sources.method: Opened the official FanDuel Connecticut house rules and read section 19.

sources.claim: 'Confidence limits for the mean are an interval estimate for the mean.' 'As a technical note, a 95 % confidence interval does not mean that there is a 95 % probability that the interval contains the true mean.' 'Instead, the level of confidence is associated with the method of calculating the interval.'
sources.method: Opened the NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook section 1.3.5.2.

sources.claim: 'The bootstrap plot is used to estimate the uncertainty of a statistic.' 'This subsample is generated with replacement so that any data point can be sampled multiple times or not sampled at all. This process is repeated for many subsamples, typically between 500 and 1000.' 'The bootstrap is not appropriate for all distributions and statistics.'
sources.method: Opened the NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook Bootstrap Plot section.

sources.claim: 'The correlation coefficient is a measure of the linear relationship between two variables.' 'A perfect linear relationship yields a correlation coefficient of +1 (or -1 for a negative relationship) and no linear relationship yields a correlation coefficient of 0.'
sources.method: Opened the official NIST Dataplot CORRELATION reference.

sources.claim: 'Doing pairwise comparison procedures over and over again for all possible pairs will not, in general, work. This is because the overall significance level is not as specified for a single pair comparison.' 'These types of investigations should be done on combinations of factors that were determined in advance of observing the experimental results'.
sources.method: Opened the NIST/SEMATECH multiple-comparisons section 7.4.7.

sources.claim: 'The Bonferroni method is a simple method that allows many comparison statements to be made (or confidence intervals to be constructed) while still assuring an overall confidence coefficient is maintained.' 'The Bonferroni method is valid for equal and unequal sample sizes.'
sources.method: Opened the NIST/SEMATECH Bonferroni section 7.4.7.3.
